lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Flight M H three seventy vanished with two hundred thirty-nine people aboard. Yet the silent jet kept answering a satellite. Seven times.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: At one nineteen a m, the cockpit radioed: Good night, Malaysian three seven zero.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Two minutes later, the transponder went dark.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: But military radar kept watching. The jet turned back across Malaysia.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: An hour later, it slipped off radar.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Then a ground station in Perth pinged it by satellite. The jet answered.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Each reply gave only a distance. A ring on the map.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: The seventh reply, at eight nineteen a m, was the last.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Its ring crossed the southern Indian Ocean.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: In twenty fifteen, part of its wing washed up on Reunion Island.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Searches swept over a hundred and twenty thousand square kilometres of seafloor. Nothing.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Malaysia has extended the hunt to June twenty twenty-seven.
